summary: Implements the concrete filesystem-backed Pending-Readiness Store (src/pcae/interactive_workflow/persistence/filesystem_pending_readiness_store.py, FilesystemPendingReadinessStore) exactly per IWPC-001 v1.1 Section 14 (IWPC-REQ-078 through IWPC-REQ-092), Section 15 (Artifact Binding), Section 17 (Readiness-Package Contract), Section 19.1, Section 21, Section 22, and Section 23. No abstract base class governs this store -- unlike Phase 145D's FilesystemSessionRepository (a concrete implementation of the pre-existing SessionRepository ABC), IWPC-001 v1.1 Section 14 defines no separate interface, and none exists elsewhere in this repository. Storage layout: .pcae/decision-sessions/pending-packages/<package_id>.json for packages not yet published, with a sibling consumed/<package_id>.json location packages move to (os.replace, never deleted) on successful publication -- explicitly frozen by IWPC-REQ-088's own literal path, nested inside the same parent directory FilesystemSessionRepository uses, without functional overlap since FilesystemSessionRepository.list_session_ids already skips directory entries. Atomicity: every create/disposition-update routes through tempfile.mkstemp (same directory) -> write -> flush -> os.fsync -> os.replace, mirroring Phase 145D's own established pattern. Wire format: a store-level schema_version ("pending-readiness-store/1.0") wraps publication_handoff_schema.to_payload's existing output unchanged, per IWPC-REQ-111. Package digest: a whole-package SHA-256 content digest computed at write time over the canonical serialization (json.dumps sort_keys=True default=str, IWPC-REQ-057) is recomputed and verified on every load, failing closed (new PendingReadinessDigestMismatchError) rather than trusting a persisted digest (IWPC-REQ-081, IWPC-REQ-165). Publication attempt binding and disposition: a single method, record_publication_attempt, appends an attempt-linkage record and, on outcome="succeeded", transitions disposition to "consumed" and moves the package (IWPC-REQ-086 through IWPC-REQ-089); idempotent by attempt_id, fails closed on a conflicting replay (new PendingReadinessAttemptConflictError) or a new attempt against an already-consumed package (new PendingReadinessAlreadyConsumedError). Recovery: load always checks the consumed/ location first, so a stale pending-side duplicate left behind by an interrupted disposition move (IWPC-REQ-154) is never mistaken for the authoritative record. Corruption detection: a new PendingReadinessStoreCorruptError is raised for malformed/truncated JSON, an unrecognized store schema_version, package/session identity self-consistency mismatches, and malformed attempt metadata; no partial/best-effort recovery is ever attempted. Security: every package_id is validated via a new is_valid_package_id generic safe-path-component check (disclosed decision: IWPC-REQ-163 anticipates a package-id format PublicationHandoff.build_package does not yet implement) before any filesystem path is constructed; symlinked package files and a symlinked storage root are both refused. Concurrency: no locking primitive is present in the module; create provides real mutual exclusion for initial creation; record_publication_attempt is idempotent by attempt_id at the store layer, consistent with PEC-001's own exclusive-create idempotency marker remaining the sole real compare-and-set mechanism this contract relies on (IWPC-REQ-144, unmodified). No CLI command, transport adapter, decision-session command handler, application service, publication orchestration, governance-record publish, or engineering execution capability was implemented; no IWC-001/PEC-001/CHGR-001/IWPC-001 contract text was changed; FilesystemSessionRepository was not modified. See docs/PHASE_145E_PENDING_READINESS_STORE_CONCRETE_FILESYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
